title: Aptoide becomes the first rival app store to return to Google Play in the US
summary: Court-ordered changes to Android are allowing competing app stores to return to Google Play. Aptoide has become the first rival to do so after more than a decade away, marking a significant shift in mobile app distribution.
content: Aptoide has brought its games store back to Google Play after more than a decade, as court-ordered changes open Android to competing app stores.

zh.title: Aptoide成为首个回归美国谷歌应用商店的竞争应用商店
zh.summary: 法院强制要求的Android改变允许竞争应用商店回归谷歌应用商店。Aptoide在沉寂十多年后成为首个这样做的竞争对手，标志着移动应用分发领域的重大转变。

title: Social media platforms still facing thousands of user addiction lawsuits after failed appeals
summary: Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, and Google continue to face thousands of lawsuits alleging their platforms are addictive and harmful to users. The platforms' appeal efforts have failed, extending their legal battles over addiction claims.
content: Platforms like Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, and Google are facing a long road of litigation.

zh.title: 社交媒体平台在上诉失败后仍面临数千起用户成瘾诉讼
zh.summary: Meta、TikTok、Snapchat和Google继续面临数千起诉讼，指控其平台具有成瘾性且对用户有害。这些平台的上诉努力已失败，延长了它们围绕成瘾指控的法律纠纷。

title: YouTube now requires creators to have twice as many watch hours to start earning money
summary: YouTube has doubled its monetization threshold, requiring creators to achieve 8,000 watch hours or 20 million Shorts views before earning revenue. This stricter requirement may impact smaller creators' ability to generate income from the platform.
content: Creators who want to start earning on the platform will need at least 8,000 qualified watch hours over the past year or 20 million qualified Shorts views in the last 90 days.

zh.title: YouTube现在要求创作者需要两倍的观看时长才能开始赚钱
zh.summary: YouTube已将其盈利门槛提高一倍，要求创作者达到8,000小时观看时长或2,000万Shorts浏览量才能获得收益。这个更严格的要求可能会影响小型创作者从该平台获得收入的能力。

title: Clicks’ Power Keyboard brings BlackBerry-style typing to any phone — with some compromises
summary: Clicks launched a $99 slide-out physical keyboard accessory for smartphones with MagSafe and Qi2 compatibility, reviving BlackBerry-style typing. The accessory adds weight that may make larger phones cumbersome, representing a trade-off between typing comfort and portability.
content: Clicks’ $99 Power Keyboard brings a customizable, slide-out physical keyboard to MagSafe and Qi2 smartphones, but its added heft can make larger phones awkward to use.

zh.title: Clicks Power Keyboard为任何手机带来黑莓式键盘体验——但需做出妥协
zh.summary: Clicks推出了一款99美元的滑出式物理键盘配件，支持MagSafe和Qi2兼容性，重振了黑莓式打字体验。该配件增加了重量，可能会使大型手机变得不便携，代表了打字舒适性和便携性之间的权衡。

summary: Ford is reportedly developing a new budget-friendly crossover priced around $25,000, roughly the size of its Escape model. Details emerged after an insider tip from a dealer, suggesting the company's plans to compete in the affordable vehicle segment.

title: Meta’s new Glimmer AI model offers a hint at Zuckerberg’s personal intelligence vision
summary: Meta released the open-weight Muse Glimmer AI model, revealing Mark Zuckerberg's vision for personal AI superintelligence accessible to users. The model highlights emerging divisions in the AI industry between proprietary and open-source systems.

title: Valve slowly expands SteamOS support on non-Valve hardware
summary: Valve is gradually expanding SteamOS compatibility beyond its Steam Deck handheld, with new updates supporting non-Valve devices like the Intel-based MSI Claw 8 EX AI+. The expansion signals growing openness to third-party hardware running Valve's gaming operating system.
content: New update includes improvements for the Intel-based MSI Claw 8 EX AI+ among others.

title: Following Epic loss, Google has started hosting rival app stores in the Play Store

title: Archer buys former rival Wisk Aero

title: One of China's workhorse rockets just exploded in flight

title: A researcher bought noreply.net. Companies started sending him secrets.
summary: A researcher who purchased the noreply.net domain began receiving sensitive company secrets as businesses mistakenly sent confidential information to the address. The discovery reveals how companies often treat certain email domains as non-functional, creating unintended security vulnerabilities.
content: Companies treat some email domains as digital trash cans, despite the risks.

zh.summary: 一位购买了noreply.net域名的研究员开始收到敏感的公司机密，因为企业误将机密信息发送到该地址。这一发现揭示了公司如何常常将某些电子邮件域名视为非功能性的，从而造成意想不到的安全漏洞。

title: Steam hardware shipper breach leaks customer data, including names and addresses
summary: Valve reported that CEVA Logistics, its European shipping partner, experienced a data breach between July 29th and August 1st that likely exposed customer names, addresses, phone numbers, and email addresses. The exposure affects customers who ordered Steam hardware during this period, as CEVA stores delivery information for up to 90 days.
content:
Valve says a data breach may have exposed the personal information of customers who ordered its Steam hardware in Europe. In an email sent to users, Valve says its European shipping partner, CEVA Logistics, suffered a data breach that may have included customer names, addresses, phone numbers, and email addresses.
The breach at CEVA occurred between July 29th and August 1st, weeks after Valve began taking reservations for its new Steam Machine and Steam Controller. Valve adds that European customer data "was likely compromised" as part of the breach, as CEVA stores "delivery-related information" for up to 90 days after orders.

title: The first rival Android app store just arrived in the US Play Store
summary: Following Google's legal disputes with Epic, the Google Play Store now lists third-party app stores alongside official offerings, with Aptoide becoming the first rival mobile game store available this way in the US.
content:
Google appears to have prepared a dedicated section for third-party app stores within Google Play, and Aptoide is just the first. | Screenshot: Google Play Store	

Following the latest twist in Google's legal battles with Epic, US Android users are now able to open Google's Play Store and download a third-party digital store with its own selection of apps. Aptoide, a store specializing in mobile games, is the first to become available.
Third-party app stores have always been available on Android, which is a more open platform than iOS in that respect. However, until now they've only been available if pre-installed on a device - as with the Amazon Appstore on Fire tablets or Samsung's Galaxy Store - or installed via sideloading. title: Ford’s new AI assistant can check your fuel levels and tire pressure
summary: Ford is rolling out an AI-powered assistant in its mobile apps that answers vehicle-related questions about fuel levels, tire pressure, and towing capacity by accessing the car's real-time data and specifications.
content:
Ford is rolling out a new AI-powered assistant that can answer questions about your Ford or Lincoln vehicle, such as how much fuel you'll need for your next road trip or whether your truck can tow that new motor boat.
The app is rolling out first to the Ford and Lincoln mobile apps, where it will work as a chatbot that can answer questions about the vehicle's capabilities or future service needs. Since the app is linked to the customer's vehicle, the assistant knows many of the details about the particular make and model, including fuel levels, cargo capacity, and towing capabilities. title: Space mirrors could ruin astronomy — and your eyes
summary: Reflect Orbital plans to launch Eärendil-1, a test satellite that uses space-based mirrors to reflect sunlight for power generation and illumination, raising concerns about potential interference with astronomical observations and safety hazards.
content:
Solar energy, at any time of day or night - that's the dream of space mirror projects. Futurists have been imagining satellite mirrors that could reflect the sun's light onto the Earth's surface for over a century. Russian scientists experimented with the concept in the '90s with the Znamya project. The idea is to put a large mirror in orbit and angle it such that sunlight can be reflected onto a specific geographical area for illumination or the generation of solar power.
